description: Launch an AI agent that navigates a website to answer a question. It reads each page (scrolling to load lazy content) and follows links across multiple pages; it does not click buttons or fill in forms.

allowNavigation.description: Allow the agent to follow links to other pages (default: true)

maxPages.description: Maximum number of pages the agent may visit (default: 5, max: 15)

maxSteps.description: Maximum number of navigation steps the agent may take (default: 10)

prompt.description: The question to answer or task to complete, e.g. "Find the pricing page and extract all plan names and prices"

url.description: The starting URL for the agent

name: agent
